description: Generated by running customer360-promotions personalization/cohorts.py cohort_key. Both the ad server and the backend cohort_patterns job load these vectors so the two implementations cannot drift. Algorithm: the two strongest positive tag or advertiser affinities (scores rounded to 3 decimals, ties alphabetical), written alphabetically and joined with '+', or 'none'; then '@' and the device class (mobile, tablet, desktop, else 'any').

vectors.name: two strongest of three, tag and advertiser mixed
negative and zero scores are not interests
ad_type and format never form a cohort
scores equal at three decimals tie
